findings.detail: Source Coupon cell states 12.96% PIK for the senior subordinated loan, but extracted interest_rate is blank.

rationale: X02 flags the PRIVATE_CREDIT row because interest_rate and basis_spread are missing. The raw SOI row for 22 HoldCo Limited shows a stated coupon of 12.96% PIK on the senior subordinated loan, so the blank extracted interest_rate is an extraction gap rather than an absence of source rate data.
